The natural energy uncertainty (linewidth) of a state with lifetime \(\tau\) is approximately

\[
\Delta E \sim \frac{\hbar}{\tau},
\qquad \hbar \approx 6.58\times10^{-16}\ \text{eV}\cdot\text{s}.
\]

Thus,

\[
\Delta E_1 \sim \frac{6.58\times10^{-16}}{10^{-9}}
=6.58\times10^{-7}\ \text{eV},
\]

\[
\Delta E_2 \sim \frac{6.58\times10^{-16}}{10^{-8}}
=6.58\times10^{-8}\ \text{eV}.
\]

To clearly resolve the levels, their separation should exceed the combined linewidth, roughly \(7\times10^{-7}\,\text{eV}\). Among the choices, only \(10^{-4}\,\text{eV}\) is sufficiently large.

Answer: B
